name: Plaid API
summary: Connect to business bank accounts and credit cards for transaction and balance data.
whatItDoes: Aggregates bank balances, inflows, outflows, and categorized transactions — essential for cash flow forecasting, expense monitoring, and real-time liquidity visibility.
actionsSupported: Link bank accounts via Plaid Link
authenticationType: API keys + Plaid Link (OAuth-style bank consent)
privacyNotes: Bank credentials never touch your servers — Plaid handles institution auth. Store only access tokens securely and honor user revocation.
